# L and L Trip Logger

> Free occupational driver's license (ODL) trip log for Texas drivers, provided by L and L Law Group, PLLC (Frisco, TX). No account. Data stays on the user's device. Exports a court-ready PDF.

## What it does
- Records date, departure/arrival time, origin, destination, purpose, and start/end odometer for each trip
- Calculates miles per trip and total miles
- Exports a letter-size PDF with a signature line

## Legal context
- Texas Transportation Code §521.248 sets the hours, days, purposes and areas an occupational license order may allow; courts commonly require a written trip log.
